title: Autonomous Discovery Across Sections 01-05
series: Adapt-1 Research Series — Part 2: Forecasting Through Drift (Companion Discovery Audit)

provenance.substrate: Hosted Adapt-1 reference deployment (v0.1.0), 100% pure native API outputs with zero client-side calibration, ensembling, or overrides.
provenance.pairing_discipline: Every Discovery metric is paired directly against the exact same out-of-sample rows, dates, or episode seeds in Sections 01-05 (full OOS on Exp 98A n=450, Exp 89B n=323, and Exp 102C n=1,800; paired chronological slices on Exp 79B n=200, Exp 79A n=200, Exp 16 n=250w, Exp 53 n=100 tickets, Exp 103A 2026 n=2,928; paired seeds on Exp 96B n=2 and Exp 93A/C n=5).

tier1_dropin_wins: Exp 98A German Power Transition Discovery (450d): 60.84 EUR/MWh 4D ES (beats all 12/12 GJR-GARCH variants at 63.08 and Authored Kernel at 65.26 with 0 hand-picked input_paths)
Exp 98A German Power Structure Discovery (450d): 476 active @lag[1..2]/interaction features, 0.8065 AUROC (92.4% coverage) on evening peak spikes, 4 native solar-glut drift detections

Exp 89B EU 4-TSO Dunkelflaute Chronos-2 Airbag (full 323d OOS): #1/25 at 0.769808 4D ES (vs authored 0.771524; exact 150d match 0.786943 vs 0.790773), EUR 991.87M/yr 20x VoLL cost (vs EUR 1,000.79M/yr authored), 7 severe outages, and VaR95 5.88% (19/323, p_cc=0.2361 PASS) by recovering all 5 authored features plus autonomously adding GPRD
Exp 79B Crypto Cascade (200 events incl. Oct 2025 crash): 0.7340 5D ES within 0.8% of hand-authored 0.7283

Exp 102C German Power Pool Two-Stage Discovery -> /value/* (1,800 full OOS): pruning 20 -> 8 features ranks #1/15 overall with Brier 0.14933 (vs 0.18012 warm-start, 0.15431 matched Online_HGBR_Disc8, and 0.15627 full-20 Online_HGBR), LogLoss 0.46342, AUROC 0.8440, ECE 0.05297, #1/15 P_EVE Brier 0.12937, and 9/14 Holm Brier & LogLoss wins (0 Holm losses)
Exp 16 19-Yr 5-Asset Macro (250w raw return units): 2.5632 5D ES dead-heat parity (+0.11%) vs hand-authored single-feature vix_term (2.5605)
Exp 53 Chicago 311 Revisions (100 tickets): autonomously discovers all 10/10 mixed categorical+numeric covariates and preserves strict monotonic tightening (0.593 -> 0.368 -> 0.283)

Exp 93C 6-Node DAG Empirical Topology Discovery (5 paired seeds): empirical_topology_inference=true with empty effect_catalog, no objective_model, and feature_paths=[] recovers 74.2% of full authored return (+3.092 vs +4.168; 4.0/6 healthy closes, 0.0 broken closes)
tier2_pin_structural_keys: Exp 103A Crypto Funding (2026 OOS): autonomous_projection pruned 19 -> 8 features but dropped pooled entity-ID flags (is_btc, is_eth, own_f8), raising Brier from 0.14814 to 0.18520. Pin structural entity-IDs and let Discovery prune noisy covariates.

Exp 79A SPY/TLT Flip (200d): autonomous_projection dropped f_corr_sb (stable during pre-2022 warmup), raising 4D ES from 1.3493 to 1.4199. Pin known slow-moving regime switches while letting Discovery select high-frequency covariates.
surface_routing_notes: Exp 96B Recurring Nonlinear Shifts (2 paired seeds): learning.context.feature_paths=[] is not wired to autonomous_projection (which operates on learning.transition), dropping A2 first-10 recall from 80.0% to 10.0%.

Exp 93A 120-World K8s POMDP (5 paired seeds): zero-ontology sequential learning (-0.688) cannot substitute for explicit finite-world belief search (+1.524 paired) when latent fault space is unfactored.

Exp 102C / 103A Symbolic Structure Discovery: discrete symbolic rules wake up cleanly (43 and 32 active features) but fire majority-class rules on imbalanced binary targets (AUROC 0.406 and 0.500), where continuous /value/* models belong.
